workspace.description: the workspace directory of the agent's task

allowlisted.description: {0} is allowlisted, as recorded by the network layer: the host is on the network allowlist

confirmed.description: {0} is confirmed, as recorded by the harness: the user confirmed the action in a dialog

deletes.description: {0} deletes {1}, as recorded by the file tools and the shell tracer

messages.description: {0} messages {1}, as recorded by the mail and chat tools

readonly.description: {0} is readonly, as recorded by the shell classifier: the command changes nothing

reads.description: {0} reads {1}, as recorded by the file tools and the shell tracer

reported.description: {0} is reported, as recorded by the harness: the action was reported to the user

resides_in.description: {0} resides in {1}, as resolved by the path resolver

writes.description: {0} writes {1}, as recorded by the file tools and the shell tracer
